DemoPage.line_intro: Hi, I'm Gigi from Girhouse! I made this demo just for your business: in six steps I'll show you your new page and the system that works for you when you can't answer. Press Let's start!
DemoPage.line_landing_hero: This is {company}'s new page. It loads fast on a phone and the buttons to book and write are always in sight.
DemoPage.line_landing_services: Here are your services, explained simply: visitors get at once what you do and how to book.
DemoPage.line_landing_about: A section about who you are. It is what makes people pick you over someone else.
DemoPage.line_landing_reviews: Your real {source} reviews, shown as {source} shows them: {rating} stars from {count} reviews. Your best business card.
DemoPage.line_landing_funnel: This is our review system: after each visit the customer gets a message. Try it: tap a star and see what happens.
DemoPage.line_landing_contact: At the bottom, hours, address and the WhatsApp button always at hand. Press Next and I'll show you what happens when someone writes.
DemoPage.line_chat_start: Say {customer} writes to you while you're with a customer. Look: 30 seconds later they already have an answer, on behalf of {company}.
DemoPage.line_chat_slots: The system listens to what they need, answers with empathy and offers two free times from your calendar.
DemoPage.line_chat_booked: {customer} picks a time and the appointment is set, with a reminder. You didn't lift a finger.
DemoPage.line_crm_contact: Meanwhile, on your side, {customer} already has a card, filled in on its own: where they came from, what they need, when they come.
DemoPage.line_crm_timeline: Here is their timeline: every step stays tracked, from the missed call to the reminder. You always know where each customer stands.
DemoPage.line_crm_pipeline: In the pipeline you see them move from new contact to appointment set. One click opens the note the system wrote from the chat.
DemoPage.line_crm_inbox: It all lands in one inbox: {customer}'s calls, WhatsApp and emails in a single conversation, and you reply from here.
DemoPage.line_followup: And those who don't answer? An automation starts on its own: it waits, sends a WhatsApp, then an email, then starts the call. As soon as the customer answers, it stops on its own.
DemoPage.line_pricing_video: So, did you like all this? Now I imagine you want to know how much it costs. Maybe you are already thinking of huge numbers, like 2,000 or 3,000 euros… but no! Thanks to our structured system, we can offer you all of this at a price that will surprise you, only for the next few days. And that price will stay locked forever. Just remember we can only set up {slots} businesses a month, so hurry! Press «See the price».
DemoPage.line_pricing_price: Here is the price reserved for {company}, locked until the date you see. And the first week is free, to try the whole platform.
DemoPage.line_pricing_included: It includes everything you have seen, plus a WhatsApp group where our Italian team looks after you.
DemoPage.line_pricing_guarantees: Try it free and we set everything up. Remember we only take {slots} new businesses a month.
DemoPage.line_booking_phone: I'll show you everything live with someone from our team. First, leave me your WhatsApp number.
DemoPage.line_booking_slots: Great! These are the free times. Pick the one you like.
DemoPage.line_booking_confirm: Good choice. Read the notice and confirm the call.
DemoPage.line_booking_booked: Done! Talk soon. Add the event to your calendar so you don't miss it.
DemoPage.line_booking_unavailable: I can't read the calendar right now. <hl>Message me on WhatsApp</hl> and we'll pick a time together.
